{{Quote|Most poisonous serpent in the rain forest.|Tribeless Sha|<ref name="Backlash" />}}
The '''Kodashi viper''' was an [[Snake/Legends|ophidian]] indigenous to the rainforests of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. Kodashi vipers were the most [[Poison/Legends|poisonous]] serpents in Dathomir's jungles, and those who failed to heed the [[Color/Legends|multicolored]] aposematic patterns of their hides often fell victim to the Kodashi's [[Kodashi viper venom|neurotoxic venom]]. Despite the lethality of their natural defensive poison, Kodashi vipers were safely edible, and their skins were used by the natives to fashion garments.

In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], Kodashi vipers were exploited by the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] clan of [[Witches of Dathomir|Dathomiri witches]] as the means by which they attacked the annual [[Conclave of the Raining Leaves Clan and the Broken Columns Clan|gathering]] of the [[Raining Leaves Clan|Raining Leaves]] and [[Broken Columns Clan]]s. Through their [[Force power/Legends|command]] of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], the Nightsisters [[Animal bond|directed]] several Kodashi vipers into the camp of the Broken Columns, which resulted in the [[Death/Legends|deaths]] of four clansmen.

==Biology and appearance==
{{Quote|She even dresses in Kodashi colors.|[[Drola Kinn]] recognizes the easily-identifiable colors of the Kodashi viper|<ref name="Backlash" />}}
Kodashi vipers were [[Snake/Legends|serpents]] found on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]],<ref name="Backlash" /> a jungle [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Quelii sector/Legends|Quelii sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="GATORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> The aposematism of the Kodashi was evident in its [[Color/Legends|multicolored]] hide, which was predominately green but adorned with alternating bands of red and yellow. When predators and other nuisances neglected to recognize the Kodashi's warning coloration, the serpent defended itself with an [[Kodashi viper venom|extremely potent neurotoxin]] that was capable of [[Death/Legends|killing]] an adult [[Human/Legends|Human]] within [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]].<ref name="Backlash" />

==Behavior and intelligence==
{{Quote|Their stealth and power are to be admired.|[[Halliava Vurse]]|<ref name="Backlash" />}}
[[File:Dathomir.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Kodashi vipers were indigenous to Dathomir.]]
Kodashi were ectothermic [[Reptile/Legends|reptiles]] usually found in the rainforests of Dathomir, where the temperate climate was more suited to their nocturnal activities, and very seldom near places like [[Redgill Lake]], where evening temperatures were too cold. When Kodashi attacked, they coiled and struck with a bite that caused agonizing pain and delivered a dose of lethal [[Poison/Legends|venom]] for which there was no antidote. The serpent was easily subdued if grabbed securely behind its head, although it attempted to constrict the assailant during its subsequent struggle for freedom. Kodashi were also susceptible to manipulations of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], and a [[Sentience/Legends|being]] skilled in the use of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark arts]] was able to [[Animal bond|command]] multiple vipers with their [[Force power/Legends|powers]]. Despite the negative connotations associated with Kodashi vipers, the jungle natives admired them for their stealth and recognized the serpent as a viable resource. [[Gender/Legends|Women]] and men of Dathomir killed the vipers for their meat and hides, which were fashioned into colorful garments.<ref name="Backlash" />

==History==
{{Quote|Drola, think about it. Who has the Arts to command the serpents? Who wants to return things to the way they were generations ago? Who would be happy for brave men to die and for Raining Leaves women to take the blame?''"<br />"''Nightsisters.|[[Tasander Dest]] and Drola Kinn, upon realization that the Nightsisters had been in control of the Kodashi vipers|<ref name="Backlash" />}}
By [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], Kodashi vipers were recognized as the most venomous serpent in the jungles of Dathomir. As such, members of the [[Raining Leaves Clan]] of [[Witches of Dathomir|Dathomiri witches]], as well as their male counterparts of the [[Broken Columns Clan]], clad themselves in Kodashi skins and colors. That same [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the dark art&ndash;practicing [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] of Dathomir [[Spy/Legends|spied]] on the [[Conclave of the Raining Leaves Clan and the Broken Columns Clan|annual gathering]] of the Raining Leaves and Broken Columns Clans. As the congregation settled down for the evening after a full day of contests and challenges amongst each other, the Nightsisters directed six Kodashi into the camp of the Broken Columns men.<ref name="Backlash" />

One of the beings present, offworlder and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], experienced a [[Disturbance in the Force/Legends|disturbance in the Force]] caused by the Nightsisters' malicious intent and intercepted one of the serpents as it prepared to attack her husband, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han]]. Another of the serpents was killed by a discharge of [[Blaster/Legends|blasterfire]], but the remaining Kodashi found their marks and were able to kill four members of the Broken Columns Clan, men who had each placed first in various competitions from the previous day.<ref name="Backlash" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Kodashi viper was a creature created by author [[Aaron Allston]] for the fourth novel in the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series, titled ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Backlash]]'' and published in [[2010]].<ref name="Backlash" />
